description: HP Inc. is a global technology leader and creator of solutions that enable people to bring their ideas to life and connect to the things that matter most. Operating in more than 170 countries, it delivers innovative and sustainable devices, services and subscriptions for personal computing, printing, 3D printing, hybrid work, gaming and other related technologies, and it believes artificial intelligence is playing a critical role in the transformation of how people live and work, with customers beginning to recognize the benefits in security, speed and cost. Its product portfolio includes HP's new line of AI PCs and workstations built with the computing power to enable local AI processing for enhanced performance and features, as well as intelligent print features incorporated into its home, office and graphics solutions, and its reportable segments include Personal Computing, Commercial Printing, Consumer Printing, Supplies and Corporate Investments.
